model_conventions.formal_meaning: Tasks are real indices in the closed interval [N-1,N], whose endpoint difference is one; capital and labor task masses are the corresponding subinterval lengths.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source treats a continuum of tasks and reasons about its unit measure and moving endpoints.
model_conventions.checked_scope: StaticModel.lean proves endpoint width, the two subinterval lengths, and their sum; no measure-theoretic equilibrium integration claim is inferred from these algebraic facts.

model_conventions.formal_meaning: A task at I* is assigned to capital; capital tasks satisfy i <= I* and labor tasks satisfy I* < i.
model_conventions.why_needed: The two task regions need an explicit endpoint convention.
model_conventions.checked_scope: The Lean partition is exhaustive on the task continuum and the two predicates are disjoint.

model_conventions.formal_meaning: The opposing task-allocation mechanism is recorded as creation of new tasks, the wording used in the June 2017 source; no claim is made that this PDF labels it reinstatement.
model_conventions.why_needed: Later terminology should not be projected back into the pinned version as a quotation.
model_conventions.checked_scope: The Lean support theorem only states the one-for-one change in labor-task interval length when N changes and the cutoff is held fixed.

checked_proof_steps.source_step: Use strict monotonicity of gamma and W/R = gamma(cost cutoff) to order capital and labor unit costs, then set I* to the minimum of the technology and cost cutoffs.
checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: With explicit positive divisors, capital is cheaper below the cost cutoff and labor is cheaper above it; min branches, task partition, constrained displacement, and fixed-cutoff new-task expansion are Lean-proved.
checked_proof_steps.scope: Support only. Equilibrium existence, market clearing, and Proposition 1 or 2 as complete named results are not proved.

policy: Review source proof text by exact source locator and mathematical claim; Lean declaration names are navigation only and are not evidence.
Give every defect a stable unique id using letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen so source-map contracts can route its repair without depending on Lean names.
A source proof defect is not a paper/model assumption. Do not classify its repaired conclusion as validated_source_assumption.

Record every explicit formalization convention that resolves a source-model ambiguity in model_conventions, with the literal source relation and checked scope. A convention is not a literal source theorem without a source-side semantic bridge.

Record every source proof step independently checked by Lean in checked_proof_steps, including its exact source step, checked conclusion, and scope. A finite/event-level step does not silently establish an arbitrary-space, pointwise-conditioning, or arbitrary-partition claim.

For every defect, record the mathematical repair obligation and acceptance condition. Resolve it by a Lean derivation, leave it as an explicit open proof obligation, or record an explicit corrected source statement.

For every defect, separately record status_impact and status_impact_rationale. statement_impact says which source text changed; status_impact says whether the issue is a formalized note, a substantial source-paper caveat with a fully proved correction, or a partial-formalization boundary.

A proof-only defect may coexist with a source-faithful final theorem only after the replacement derivation is proved. A minor source-statement repair may also be formalized_note when the substantive advertised endpoint is unchanged. Only a substantial central source-paper error with a fully proved corrected endpoint justifies formalized_with_caveat.
